days.title: High Peaks and Glaciers
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Piz Bernina
stops.detail: Piz Bernina stands out due to its almost freestanding nature and as a result also offers unique far-reaching views from its summit.

stops.name: Biancograt
stops.detail: You'll fly close to Piz Bernina, the Biancograt, and past glaciers.

days.title: Lakes and Valley Exploration
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Upper Engadine
stops.detail: The return flight over the lake landscape of the Upper Engadine completes your flying experience.

stops.name: Valposchiavo
stops.detail: A journey on the Bernina Herb Express to Le Prese is a chance for passengers to experience the UNESCO World Heritage Site up close and immerse themselves in the world of herbs in Valposchiavo.

days.title: Southern Villages and Vineyards
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Poschiavo
stops.detail: On the Bernina Express you travel from the glaciers of the Engadine to an ice cream cone at the Mediterranean piazza of Poschiavo with many trail highlights in between.

stops.name: La Gatta winery
stops.detail: The highlight is a visit to the La Gatta winery, where you can enjoy a local lunch paired with matching wines.
